2608.01389.title: KoVRE: Training an Efficient Embedding Model for Korean Visual Document Retrieval
2608.01389.paper_summary: Visual Document Retrieval (VDR) directly matches text queries against document images, preserving visual and structural information that may be lost during text extraction. However, existing VDR models and training resources remain predominantly English-centric, while many high-performing systems rely on massive backbones or storage-intensive multi-vector representations. To address these limitations, we introduce KoVRE: Korean Visual Document Retrieval Embedding, a single-vector retriever for Korean visual documents, alongside a comprehensive training recipe. We train the model on 708,729 Korean and English query-page pairs using positive-aware hard-negative mining and conduct controlled analyses of training-data composition, hard-negative treatment, and reranker-based knowledge distillation. Across Korean visual document retrieval benchmarks, our 2B model substantially improves over the base backbone model, outperforming both its 8B single-vector counterpart and a strong multi-vector baseline. These results demonstrate that targeted bilingual supervision and our carefully designed training strategies can produce a highly effective Korean VDR model across diverse document domains, without requiring a scaled-up backbone or multi-vector representations.
2608.01389.paper_summary_zh: 視覺文件檢索（VDR）直接將文本查詢與文件圖像匹配，保留在文本提取過程中可能丟失的視覺和結構信息。<lb/>然而，現有的 VDR 模型和訓練資源仍然主要以英語為中心，而許多高效能系統依賴於龐大的骨幹或存儲密集型的多向量表示。<lb/>為了解決這些限制，我們介紹 KoVRE：韓國視覺文件檢索嵌入，這是一個針對韓國視覺文件的單向量檢索器，並提供了一個全面的訓練配方。<lb/>我們使用正向意識的困難負樣本挖掘，對 708,729 對韓文和英文查詢-頁面進行模型訓練，並對訓練數據組成、困難負樣本處理和基於重排序器的知識蒸餾進行控制分析。<lb/>在韓國視覺文件檢索基準測試中，我們的 2B 模型在基礎骨幹模型上有了顯著改善，超越了其 8B 單向量對應模型和一個強大的多向量基準。<lb/>這些結果表明，針對性的雙語監督和我們精心設計的訓練策略可以在多樣的文件領域中產生一個高效的韓國 VDR 模型，而無需擴大骨幹或使用多向量表示。
